Multipart and oversized model prompts are separate outstanding work.

Native clone assigns object IDs, defaults object extruder1, copies processed cut identity. ModelVolumeType orders blocker before enforcer. min_z uses first instance; ensure_on_bed(false) translates auto_drop instances only. center_instances uses all model-part bounds and1e-4 threshold.
LoadModel without LoadConfig skips global settings and embedded presets but still reads model config, layer profiles/ranges, brim ears and processed cut metadata.
